_how_to_edit: Each week, put this week's Divrei Torah / shiur in "items". Every field except "title" is optional. Use title/text for English and title_yi/text_yi for Yiddish (the page shows whichever matches the visitor's language and falls back to the other). "pdf" and "audio" are links (a file in this repo such as "data/files/lech-lecha.pdf", or a full https:// address). Leave "items" as [] and the page shows an elegant 'Coming this week' note.

_example_item.title: Title of the dvar Torah or shiur
_example_item.text: Plain text. A blank line starts a new paragraph.
